entries.f05f590a323f6c9c: The breakdown by region of revenue of ¥68,109 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, based on revenue from external customers, is: Japan ¥59,371 million, North America ¥5,087 million, China ¥1,926 million, and other regions (Thailand) ¥1,723 million.
